anchor.quote: Let $q$ be the number of entries in the vector
let $\omega$ be a primitive $q$-th root of unity
Let $a = (a_0, a_1, \dots, a_{q-1})$ be the input vector
The transform $\hat a = (\hat a_0, \dots, \hat a_{q-1})$ of $a$ has $q$ entries.
The index $j$ runs over the input positions
The index $k$ runs over the output positions
